questions.q: The coordinates of the three vertices of a triangle are: (1, 2), (7, 2), and (1, 10). Then the radius of the incircle of the triangle is
questions.explain: The vertices form a right-angled triangle. The side lengths are: distance between (1,2) and (7,2) is $a=6$. Distance between (1,2) and (1,10) is $b=8$. Distance between (7,2) and (1,10) is $c=\sqrt{(7-1)^2+(2-10)^2}=\sqrt{36+64}=\sqrt{100}=10$. For a right-angled triangle, the inradius ${r}$ is given by the formula $r = (a+b-c)/2$. So, $r = (6+8-10)/2 = 4/2=2$.
